name: Lacustrine-Tempest
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait frozen methane lakes, and everything the light never reaches.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
There is money in exotic matter here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
